'''September 2001 Pleasanton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Warmasters, Pleasanton, California on 1 September 2001. [[Paul McKelvey]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2956">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-10-longshot-in-pleasanton-9-1-01d2956/ longshot-in-pleasanton-9-1-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 10 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-10-longshot-in-pleasanton-9-1-01d2956/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 1 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Warmasters, Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul McKelvey]]
